t: $(thing)Upgrades/$ improve a $(l:intro/modular_router)Modular Router's/$ functionality in various ways.  There are 8 different upgrade types, and 5 upgrade slots in an Modular Router.$(p)You can put multiple upgrades in an upgrade slot, although there is a limit on how many upgrades of a particular type can be inserted; see the individual upgrade pages or upgrade item tooltips for more information on this.
$(thing)升级/$可以从多个方面增强$(l:intro/modular_router)物品路由器/$的功能。升级共有 8 种类型，而一台物品路由器有 5 个升级槽。$(p)你可以在一个升级槽中放入多个升级，不过每种升级可插入的数量有限制；详情请参阅各升级页面或升级物品提示。
